notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Mindless Automaton.
You have a way to draw a card except the first card you draw during your draw step.
description:
Draw a card, instead causing you to draw two cards due to Teferi's Ageless Insight.
Shabraz triggers twice.
Resolve a Shabraz trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to gain 1 life.
Mindless Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat from step 2.
